blockers.title: Student edit autosave is dropped when phone Back, bottom navigation or app close happens during the 500 ms debounce
blockers.scenario: Allievi > student > Modifica > type a phone number > swipe/press phone Back within 500 ms (the status line is blank during the debounce, so nothing warns the user). The profile appears, updateStudent is never called and the edit is gone. Probe A confirmed it with the real component: updates [] and phone still null after 1.2 s. The in-app Back (exitForm, 559-569) and 'Fine' flush the save, but unmount cleanup only clears the timer (538). Bottom-nav Home/Avarie/Equipaggi and app close/reload follow the same path, and there is no pagehide/visibilitychange flush anywhere in src. Unmount also drops pending note dictation, which the in-app Back explicitly refuses to abandon (560-563, 'Attendi la fine della dettatura').
blockers.specReference: 01_PRODUCT_SPEC.md §1 (autosave routine valid edits), §3.3 (routine valid changes autosave), §10 (writes survive page/app closure), §2 (phone Back is a supported navigation path)
blockers.suggestedFix: Flush the latest valid snapshot on unmount, as StudentKnowledge already does (StudentKnowledge.tsx unmount effect: persist latest if not queued), and also on pagehide/visibilitychange=hidden. Add a component or browser test: type, then phone Back within 100 ms, then reload and check the value.

blockers.title: After phone Back from Modifica the profile shows stale data, and the next edit overwrites the saved change
blockers.location: src/features/students/StudentManagement.tsx:1153-1168 (popstate only calls setScreen) and 1289-1292 (refreshStudents only in onSaved)
blockers.scenario: Modifica > change Telefono > wait for 'Salvato' (persisted) > phone Back. The profile still shows 'Telefono —'. Tap Modifica again: the form opens from the stale StudentRecord with an empty phone. Change the nickname: autosave writes the full snapshot with phone=null and overwrites the saved phone. Probe B, run with the real component and a store-backed mock, confirmed this: update 1 phone='+39 333 0000000', update 2 nickname='Marietto', phone=null.
blockers.specReference: 01_PRODUCT_SPEC.md §3.3 (UI must not claim success wrongly; autosave), §10 (writes survive), §1 (honest save state)
blockers.suggestedFix: Refresh students (or merge the autosaved snapshot into state) on every exit from the edit screen, including popstate. Better: have persistEdit update the parent's students state after each successful write. Initialise StudentForm from a fresh read.

blockers.title: Phone Back skips nested screens in Barche, Avarie, Comandate and Volontari and discards their drafts
blockers.scenario: Home > Barche > tap RS Quest 7 (boat detail) > phone Back. The app lands on Home (heading 'D2 - 35 | 2026') instead of the boat list; probe D confirmed this. Only App.tsx and StudentManagement.tsx push history (grep: pushState at App.tsx:123 and StudentManagement.tsx:140 only). All other nested screens are local useState, so Back unmounts the whole area. Drafts are lost silently: a typed or dictated fault in FaultForm (Barche detail > Aggiungi avaria, or Avarie > new), an unsaved Comandate configuration, a new or edited volunteer.
blockers.specReference: 01_PRODUCT_SPEC.md §2: 'browser Back/swipe-back returns to the preceding in-app screen when there is one'; archive N1 acceptance ('test deep paths, forms, dialogs')
blockers.suggestedFix: Generalise the StudentManagement nested-history pattern (push on nested navigation, restore on popstate) into a shared hook, and apply it to BoatManagement, FaultManagement, DutyManagement and VolunteerManagement. Add a browser Back journey per area covering a nested form.

importantFindings.title: An open Valutazioni note draft is discarded by phone Back or the bottom navigation, although the in-page Back is disabled to protect it
importantFindings.location: src/features/evaluations/EvaluationManagement.tsx:529 (header Back disabled while noteStudentId set); src/App.tsx:462-479 and 629-655 (no guard)
importantFindings.scenario: Valutazioni > tap the student name > type or dictate a note > phone Back, or tap Avarie/Home/Equipaggi. The screen unmounts and saveEvaluation is never called; the note is lost with no prompt. Probes C and E confirmed this: in-page Back disabled=true, Valutazioni gone, saveEvaluation calls=0. A dictation still processing is also lost.
importantFindings.specReference: 01_PRODUCT_SPEC.md §8 (notes accept typing or voice), §9 (show editable text → save text; preserve text on failure), §2
importantFindings.suggestedFix: Treat the open note editor as a nested history entry: push on open, and on popstate close it, keeping the draft or asking to save/discard. Guard bottom navigation while a note is open or a save is failed or pending, consistently with the header Back.

importantFindings.title: Edit autosave stores a birth date after the course start (negative age); invariants accept it
importantFindings.location: src/features/students/StudentManagement.tsx:489-502 (no DOB range check), 607-613 (only the native max attribute); src/domain/invariants.ts:142-168
importantFindings.scenario: Modifica > Data di nascita = 2030-05-01, typed on desktop Chrome or picked on a picker that ignores max. Autosave persists it without form validation, and the profile shows 'Età -4 anni' and a minor marker. Probe F confirmed this. The scan path rejects this case (StudentScan.tsx:167) and create relies on native form validation, so only edit bypasses it. The invariant checker only checks that the DOB is non-empty, so malformed or calendar-invalid values are not rejected either.
importantFindings.specReference: 01_PRODUCT_SPEC.md §3.1 (age calculated on first course day; do not fabricate data), §10 (true technical invalidity blocks storage)
importantFindings.suggestedFix: In persistEdit, reject a DOB that is not a valid YYYY-MM-DD date or is after course.startDate, and show the reason. Add DOB format, calendar and range checks to validateCourseState.

importantFindings.title: UG2 cannot yet prove the 0.2.0 migration: no 0.2.0-shaped fixture, and the invariant snapshot lacks 0.3.0 fields
importantFindings.scenario: The compatibility script only feeds 0.1.0 JSON through validateCourseState, not through the production readers (readCrewPlan, readDutyPlan, listStudents with validateStudentRecords). No fixture carries 0.2.0 data (courseNote, extraDayIds, CT role, a D1/Cabinato flexible crew with more than four members and null capacity). CourseStateSnapshot has no crew capacity or member slot positions, and the full-week scenario has no age-only students, flexible capacities or sparse slots. UG2 explicitly requires proving 0.1.0/0.2.0 migrations including age-only records. The schema changes are additive and read-normalised, so the product risk is low, but the gate evidence does not exist yet.
importantFindings.suggestedFix: Add a v0.2.0 fixture seeded with the 0.2.0 schema and run it through the production readers and a browser reopen. Extend the snapshot and scenario with capacity, slot positions, age-only and declared-age students, and DOB validity.

qolFindings.title: Saving a manual student started from Scan returns to the Scan screen, not the list
qolFindings.scenario: Allievi > Scan > Inserisci manualmente > Salva allievo. backStudentScreen does history.back() to the scan entry, so a fresh Scan start screen appears; the new student is visible only after a second Back.
qolFindings.suggestedFix: After a create reached from Scan, replace the history entry or go back twice to the list.

qolFindings.title: Back to Valutazioni after the E1 exact-session route restores the last-used session and view, not the ones that entry showed
qolFindings.scenario: Valutazioni (Riepilogo, session S1) > student > tap history cell S2 > Back > Back. Valutazioni reopens on S2 in 'Allievi'. The history entry does not carry session or view, and after a reload the E1 session is also forgotten.
qolFindings.suggestedFix: Store evaluationSessionId and evaluationView in the shell history entry and restore them on popstate.

qolFindings.title: The first phone Back on Home after launch appears inert
qolFindings.scenario: Cold launch with null history state: AppShell pushes (rather than replaces) a home entry. Back pops to the null entry, the handler sets view 'home' and nothing visibly changes; a second Back exits. This may be an intentional guard, but it is undocumented.
qolFindings.suggestedFix: Use replaceState for the initial home entry, or document the double-Back guard.

qolFindings.title: saveEvaluation is a non-transactional read-then-insert with no uniqueness guard; a duplicate would make the session unreadable
qolFindings.scenario: Two overlapping saves for the same student and session both see no row and both INSERT. validateRows then throws for that session, Riepilogo and profile history forever, and there is no in-app repair. The UI serialises per card, so a realistic trigger is only a remount race.
qolFindings.suggestedFix: Wrap the read and write in db.writeTransaction, as the student, crew and duty writes already are.

qolFindings.title: No React error boundary: any render-time throw blanks the whole app
qolFindings.scenario: A malformed persisted DOB passes validateStudentRecords, then calculateStudentAge throws during the StudentList render and leaves a white screen with no Riprova. Not reachable through current inputs; it matters only for corrupt or legacy rows.
qolFindings.specReference: 01_PRODUCT_SPEC.md §10 (routine recoverable errors stay in context with retry)
qolFindings.suggestedFix: Add a top-level error boundary with the existing 'Nessun dato è stato cancellato / Riprova' screen, and tighten DOB invariants (see PN-5).
